output.summary: Turnover rose from 28% to 47%, and payroll reconciliation shows the increase is real. It is not a migration artifact, because it was already elevated in Oct-Nov, before the December 2025 HRIS move. Monthly separations stepped up in March 2026, before the April ShiftWise go-live, and did not rise further afterward. That step lines up with the March Saturday-hours change. Pay was the top exit-survey reason in both years (58% vs 61%), so it does not explain the change. Schedule complaints rose from 19% to 48%. Market pay is unknown, and there is no branch-level data. A blanket 15% raise and manager penalties are not justified yet. Next, get the branch-level and pre/post-ShiftWise cuts and a pay benchmark.
